title: Fix Tauri updater startup config crash
summary: Add a valid inert updater plugin configuration so the Tauri shell can initialize in development without private-beta updater endpoints.
reason: The Tauri shell registered tauri-plugin-updater, but the default tauri.conf.json had no plugins.updater object. Tauri deserialized that as null and panicked before backend setup or WebView window creation.
behavior_before: Tauri dev launch exited with code 101 during plugin initialization before opening the WebView window.
behavior_after: Tauri dev launch initializes the updater plugin with an inert no-endpoint config and can continue into normal backend/WebView startup.

rollback_plan: Remove the plugins.updater block from tauri.conf.json if the updater plugin is removed from Cargo.toml, or replace it with the productized updater config generated by ops/scripts/release/New-TauriProductizationConfig.ps1.
notes: Does not add updater UI, update checks, network endpoints, signing keys, or media/backend behavior changes.
